  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The comments-first lookup can read comments even when the issue body contains a matching report.
  WHY: This adds comments reads compared with returning on a body match; reviewers characterize the cost as bounded, not a runtime failure.
- CLAUDE.md:1357; agents.md:1196 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The documented lookup budget says one comments read per checked hit, while `gh_api_list` makes one API call per 100 comments.
  WHY: A checked issue with more than 100 comments requires multiple API calls, so the documented budget can undercount reads.
- workflow-templates/.claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py:1057-1058 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: A comments-read `ReadError` can prevent lookup from checking an issue body that contains the only matching report.
  WHY: A transient comments API failure can cause a retry instead of returning the body match; the reviewer notes this delays detection rather than producing a false `found: false`.
